method: ZIP/class constant-pool inventory plus javap -c -p; no downloaded class executed
findings: UpdateClient.onInitializeClient registers WorldGuiSession toggle key, START_CLIENT_TICK hook, and vanilla title dashboard button before reading the channel config. Preserve the entrypoint.
connected() returns true only when endpoint and key are nonblank. Empty manifestUrl and publicKey make it false.
onInitializeClient connected() guard gates MultiplayerPromotion.register(endpoint), startup check(), and five-minute update timer.
check() independently requires connected(), !staged, and busy.compareAndSet(false,true) before asynchronous network work.
available defaults null and is set only in lambda$check$5. download() returns immediately when available is null.
PYESClientScreen and PyesTitleScreen only call guarded check() and open UpdateScreen; no bypassing direct update network invocation found.

MultiplayerPromotion.register itself returns for a blank endpoint. Its only registration caller is the connected branch. Its refresh path uses UpdateClient.get and is therefore unreachable through shipped lifecycle with empty config.
UpdateScreen disables check action when !connected(); download requires available.
limitations: This is static control-flow inspection of the supplied outer JAR, not device gameplay or a complete security audit.
Retained public methods could be invoked by another mod or reflection; no such invocation was found in the supplied outer JAR.
This does not undo an updater process already staged by a previous installation. The launcher installs a new private instance.
Nested mods and Java/Minecraft networking were not audited here.
